{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2019}}
{{main|2019 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''mixed doubles''' competition of the [[2019 World Table Tennis Championships]] was held from 22 to 26 April 2019.<ref>{{cite web |title=Liebherr 2019 World Table Tennis Championships / Schedule |url=https://www.ittf.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/07/2019-WTTC_HUN_Schedule_32T.pdf |website=ITTF |accessdate=22 January 2019}}</ref> [[Maharu Yoshimura]] and [[Kasumi Ishikawa]] were the defending champions. Ishikawa initially teamed up with [[Tomokazu Harimoto]], but Harimoto was replaced by Yoshimura due to an injury.<ref>{{cite web|title=Entry list|url=https://oes.ittf.com/view/event/entries/e33449f4-4cc0-4383-b6a2-d151aa14e33c/detail|website=ITTF |accessdate=3 April 2019}}</ref>

[[Xu Xin (table tennis)|Xu Xin]] and [[Liu Shiwen]] won the title after defeating Maharu Yoshimura and Kasumi Ishikawa 11–5, 11–8, 9–11, 11–9, 11–4.<ref>{{cite web|title=Chinese Duo Xu Xin & Liu Shiwen Topple Defending Champions to be Crowned Mixed Doubles World Champions|url=https://www.ittf.com/2019/04/27/chinese-duo-xu-xin-liu-shiwen-topple-defending-champions-crowned-mixed-doubles-world-champions/|website=ITTF |accessdate=26 April 2019}}</ref>
